# Sample data

These synthetic listings and findings exercise three power bank outcomes. Their
reviews, measurements, and prices are examples created for tests.

| Fixture | Evidence | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| `sample-power-bank-low` | Two independent USB testers record 4,000 mAh and 5 Ah at the port for a 20,000 mAh option | RED Q3 |
| `sample-power-bank-normal` | A USB tester records 13,000 mAh at the port for the same advertised capacity, with ten checked reviews | GREEN Q5 |
| `sample-power-bank-complaint` | One buyer reports low capacity without a measurement | YELLOW Q4 |

The example power bank profile is pending human review.
